---
title: "A page image does not inherit a dimension the page leaves out"
open-graph:
  image: square.svg
  image-width: 10
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="10">'
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image:height"'
---

The page declares only the width of its image, so the site's height is not used for it.
